instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: I want brief routine updates immediately while I work alone. A routine update can wait until my video call ends.
context.task: The bin is full. Give the person a low-priority completion update.
context.observed_robot_action: Give the spoken update at the person's next pause.

motion_options.A: Demonstrate the timing: resume writing and tap the announcement button before putting the pencil down.
motion_options.B: Demonstrate the timing: resume writing and tap the announcement button after putting the pencil down.
